newsitem.title: USA: Diatide starts Phase 3 trials of agent.
newsitem.headline: Diatide starts Phase 3 trials of agent.

text.p: Diatide Inc said Friday it has begun Phase 3 clinical trials of its P829 Techtide, an imaging agent used in diagnosing non-small cell lung cancer.
The company said this is the third set of Phase 3 trials for P829, which is also being evaluated as an imaging agent in detecting neuroendocrine and melanoma tumors.
The new trials involve comparing P829 against computerized tomography, it said. The trials began December 23 in Phoenix, Ariz., and are to involve about 260 patients at about 20 locations.
The trials are to be completed this year.
